content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has established the Standards of Care in Diabetes, which provide detailed guidelines on current clinical practices, treatment objectives, and tools for assessing diabetes management. These standards are meticulously updated on an annual basis by the ADA’s Professional Practice Committee to ensure they incorporate the latest advancements in diabetes technology. This includes innovations in devices and software designed to support patients in self-management of their condition and to enhance overall clinical outcomes.
